data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg and/or 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight and percent change in body weight

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Eloralintide 1.5 mg Body Weight
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 1.5 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight and percent change in body weight

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg, and/or 9 mg Multiple Endpoints
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg, and/or 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight, body weight reduction thresholds, body composition, central adiposity, glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Pooled Eloralintide Lipids and Blood Pressure
data.text: To demonstrate that pooled eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in lipid parameters and blood pressure

data.name: Secondary Objective - Dose-Response Body Weight and Composition
data.text: To assess the effect of eloralintide dose relative to placebo for change in body weight, central adiposity, body composition, BMI, glycemic control, lipid parameters, blood pressure, inflammatory biomarkers, biomarkers of insulin sensitivity, medication use, renal function, health-related quality of life, health status, eating behavior, and physical function

data.name: Secondary Objective - Eloralintide 1.5 mg Multiple Endpoints
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 1.5 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight, body weight reduction thresholds, body composition, central adiposity, and glycemic control

data.name: Secondary Safety Objective
data.text: To describe the safety of eloralintide compared to placebo

data.name: Secondary PK/PD Objective
data.text: To characterize eloralintide PK and evaluate dose and/or exposure-response relationships between eloralintide and key efficacy, safety and tolerability measures.

data.name: Primary Treatment-Regimen Estimand - Percent Change in Body Weight
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with obesity or overweight (BMI >27 kg/m2) and Type 2 Diabetes (clinical diagnosis for at least 6 months prior to screening) with at least 1 self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population) Summary measure: Difference in mean percent change from baseline in body weight at Week 64 between eloralintide and placebo.

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation or non-adherence
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant permanently discontinues study intervention or does not adhere to the assigned treatment regimen before Week 64. Under the treatment-regimen estimand, treatment adherence is considered part of the treatment condition and no ICE is formally defined; all data are used regardless of adherence.

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of prohibited weight management treatments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates prohibited weight management treatments during the study. Under the treatment-regimen estimand, this is considered part of the treatment condition and no ICE is formally defined; all data are used regardless of initiation of prohibited treatments.
